figures.description: Durability Considerations Durability assessment and design life considerations for steel, concrete, and timber piles in various environments. figures.description: Rock Exploration Methods (Coring / Drilling) Rock exploration and quality assessment for driven pile foundations bearing on or driven to rock. figures.caption: H-piles with driving shoes
